title: Spoilage Credit on Weighed Grocery Lines Under Photo Review
content:
# Spoilage credit on weighed grocery lines under photo review

Case digest for Cartwise Grocery Orders photo-review claims on lines sold by weight.

**Rule.** When at least 2 calendar days have passed from the date of the order's completion to today and the claimed line was billed on more weight than was requested, a spoilage credit of 2.00 is added to the photo-review claim amount; when at least 2 calendar days have passed and the claimed line was billed on no more weight than was requested, the credit is 1.00; otherwise there is none. The credit is added after the claim figure is rounded to the cent.

Calendar days are counted from the date part of the completion time as day 0. The weights compared are the requested quantity and the billed quantity recorded on the claimed line's billed item line entry.

## Cases (hypothetical)

**Case A — heavier than asked, two days on.** Completed on the 10th, claim priced on the 12th. Requested 2.00 pounds, billed 2.30 pounds. Credit: 2.00.

**Case B — lighter than asked, three days on.** Completed on the 10th, priced on the 13th. Requested 2.00 pounds, billed 1.85 pounds. Credit: 1.00.

**Case C — exactly the weight asked.** Completed on the 10th, priced on the 12th. Requested and billed both 1.50 pounds. Billed on no more weight than requested. Credit: 1.00.

**Case D — one day on.** Completed late on the 11th, priced on the 12th. One calendar day has passed. Credit: none, whatever the weights.

| Days since completion | Billed weight against requested | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | More | 2.00 |
| 2 or more | Equal or less | 1.00 |
| 0 or 1 | Any | None |
